topics.title: The verb "be": am, is, are
topics.titleFa: فعل be: am، is، are

teach.en: Good morning, class! Let's start with the most important verb in English: "be".
teach.fa: صبح بخیر بچه‌ها! با مهم‌ترین فعل انگلیسی شروع کنیم: «be» (بودن).

teach.en: We say "I am", "he is", "she is", "it is", and "you are", "we are", "they are".
teach.fa: می‌گوییم I am؛ he/she/it is؛ و you/we/they are.

teach.en: In everyday British English we usually shorten it: I'm, he's, she's, it's, you're, we're, they're.
teach.fa: در انگلیسی روزمره معمولاً کوتاهش می‌کنیم: I'm، he's، she's، it's، you're، we're، they're.

teach.en: For the negative, add "not": I'm not, he isn't, they aren't. For a question, swap them round: Is he five?
teach.fa: برای منفی not اضافه کنید: I'm not، he isn't، they aren't. برای سؤال جایشان را عوض کنید: Is he five?

examples.en: I'm Nicola. I'm five.
examples.fa: من نیکولا هستم. پنج سالمه.

examples.en: Tom is a bus driver. He's very funny.
examples.fa: تام رانندهٔ اتوبوس است. او خیلی بامزه است.

examples.en: We aren't late. Are you ready?
examples.fa: ما دیر نکرده‌ایم. آماده‌ای؟

practice.prompt: Nicola ___ five years old.
Tom and Leslie ___ at home.
I ___ hungry, Mummy!
Which sentence is correct?
Is Ryan at school today?
Make it negative: "It is cold today."

test.prompt: My name ___ Leslie.
You ___ my best friend!
Which question is correct?
We aren't in the kitchen.
Make it a question: "She is a teacher."

topics.title: "have got" and "has got"
topics.titleFa: have got و has got

teach.en: In Britain we often say "have got" to talk about things we own, family and illnesses.
teach.fa: در بریتانیا برای مالکیت، اعضای خانواده و بیماری‌ها اغلب می‌گوییم «have got».

teach.en: I've got, you've got, we've got, they've got. But for he, she and it: he's got, she's got, it's got.
teach.fa: I've got، you've got، we've got، they've got. اما برای he، she و it: he's got، she's got، it's got.

teach.en: Negative: I haven't got, she hasn't got. Question: Have you got…? Has he got…?
teach.fa: منفی: I haven't got، she hasn't got. سؤال: Have you got…? Has he got…?

examples.en: William has got ten toy buses.
examples.fa: ویلیام ده اتوبوس اسباب‌بازی دارد.

examples.en: I've got a cold. I haven't got a tissue!
examples.fa: سرما خورده‌ام. دستمال کاغذی ندارم!

examples.en: Have you got a pen? Yes, I have.
examples.fa: خودکار داری؟ بله، دارم.

practice.prompt: Ryan ___ got a new phone.
We ___ got a cat. Mrs Patel has.
___ you got any brothers or sisters?
Which sentence is correct?
Has Tom got a big umbrella?
answers: Has Tom got a big umbrella?

practice.prompt: Make it negative: "She's got a car."
answers: She has not got a car.

test.prompt: I ___ got a headache.
___ Leslie got a sister?
Which answer is correct? "Have you got a pound?"
They haven't got a garden.
Make it a question: "He's got a dog."

topics.title: a, an and the
topics.titleFa: a، an و the

teach.en: Use "a" or "an" for one thing when it's new or not special: a bus, an apple.
teach.fa: برای یک چیز وقتی تازه گفته می‌شود یا خاص نیست a یا an می‌گوییم: a bus، an apple.

teach.en: "An" goes before a vowel sound: an egg, an umbrella, an hour. "A" goes before other sounds: a dog, a uniform.
teach.fa: an قبل از صدای مصوت می‌آید: an egg، an umbrella، an hour. بقیه a: a dog، a uniform.

teach.en: Use "the" when we both know which one: the kitchen, the bus stop, the sun.
teach.fa: وقتی هر دو می‌دانیم کدام است the می‌گوییم: the kitchen، the bus stop، the sun.

examples.en: There's a cat in the garden. The cat is Biscuit!
examples.fa: یک گربه در باغچه است. آن گربه بیسکویت است!

examples.en: Can I have an orange juice, please?
examples.fa: یک آب‌پرتقال لطفاً؟

examples.en: Tom is a bus driver. He drives the number 38.
examples.fa: تام رانندهٔ اتوبوس است. او شمارهٔ ۳۸ را می‌راند.

practice.prompt: Nicola wants ___ ice cream.
William has got ___ red bus.
Please close ___ door. It's cold!
Which is correct?
There's an apple on the table.
answers: There's an apple on the table.

practice.prompt: Correct the mistake: "Ryan is a honest boy."

test.prompt: I've got ___ idea!
Leslie is ___ teacher.
"Where's Mummy?" "She's in ___ garden."
Tom has got an old umbrella.
answers: Tom has got an old umbrella.

test.prompt: Correct the mistake: "Can I have a egg, please?"
answers: Can I have an egg, please?

topics.title: Plurals: one bus, two buses
topics.titleFa: جمع: one bus، two buses

teach.en: For most nouns, add -s: one book, two books.
teach.fa: برای بیشتر اسم‌ها -s اضافه کنید: one book، two books.

teach.en: After s, sh, ch, x, add -es: buses, dishes, sandwiches, boxes. After a consonant + y, change y to -ies: one baby, two babies.
teach.fa: بعد از s، sh، ch و x باید -es بگذارید: buses، dishes، sandwiches، boxes. بعد از حرف بی‌صدا + y، y می‌شود -ies: babies.

teach.en: Some plurals are irregular: child, children; man, men; woman, women; tooth, teeth; foot, feet; mouse, mice.
teach.fa: بعضی جمع‌ها بی‌قاعده‌اند: child/children، man/men، woman/women، tooth/teeth، foot/feet، mouse/mice.

examples.en: William has got ten toy buses.
examples.fa: ویلیام ده اتوبوس اسباب‌بازی دارد.

examples.en: There are three children in the Thompson family.
examples.fa: در خانوادهٔ تامسون سه بچه هست.

examples.en: Brush your teeth, Nicola!
examples.fa: دندان‌هایت را مسواک بزن، نیکولا!

practice.prompt: There are two ___ in the queue.
One box, two ___
One baby, three ___
My ___ are cold! I need socks.
There are two sandwiches in my lunchbox.
answers: There are two sandwiches in my lunchbox.

practice.prompt: Make it plural: "one child" → "two …"

test.prompt: One man, two ___
The shop sells ___ and sweets.
One mouse, two ___
The ducks are on the pond.
answers: The ducks are on the pond.

test.prompt: Make it plural: "one tooth" → "two …"

topics.title: Present simple: I work, she works
topics.titleFa: حال ساده: I work، she works

teach.en: We use the present simple for habits, routines and facts: I get up at seven. Tom drives a bus.
teach.fa: حال ساده برای عادت‌ها، کارهای روزمره و واقعیت‌هاست: I get up at seven. Tom drives a bus.

teach.en: With he, she and it, add -s or -es: she works, he watches, it goes.
teach.fa: با he، she و it، -s یا -es اضافه کنید: she works، he watches، it goes.

teach.en: Negative: I don't like… / he doesn't like…. Questions: Do you…? Does she…? After "doesn't" and "does", the verb has no -s.
teach.fa: منفی: I don't like / he doesn't like. سؤال: Do you…? Does she…? بعد از doesn't و does فعل -s نمی‌گیرد.

examples.en: Leslie teaches at a primary school.
examples.fa: لزلی در یک دبستان درس می‌دهد.

examples.en: Ryan doesn't like mornings.
examples.fa: رایان صبح‌ها را دوست ندارد.

examples.en: Do you take sugar in your tea?
examples.fa: در چایت شکر می‌ریزی؟

practice.prompt: Tom ___ the number 38 bus.
I ___ like mushrooms.
___ Nicola go to school?
Which sentence is correct?
William goes to bed at seven.
answers: William goes to bed at seven.

practice.prompt: Make it negative: "Ryan plays football."

test.prompt: Leslie ___ tea every morning.
___ you live in Hackney?
Which question is correct?
We don't watch TV at breakfast.
answers: We don't watch TV at breakfast.

test.prompt: Make it a question: "She likes cats."

topics.title: can and can't
topics.titleFa: can و can't

teach.en: Use "can" for ability and permission: I can swim. Can I have a biscuit?
teach.fa: can برای توانایی و اجازه است: I can swim. Can I have a biscuit?

teach.en: "Can" is the same for everyone: I can, she can, they can. Never add -s, and never add "to": she can drive.
teach.fa: can برای همه یکی است: I can، she can، they can. هیچ‌وقت -s یا to نمی‌گیرد: she can drive.

teach.en: Negative: can't. Question: Can you…? In British English "can't" sounds like "carnt".
teach.fa: منفی: can't. سؤال: Can you…? در لهجهٔ بریتانیایی can't شبیه «کانت» تلفظ می‌شود.

examples.en: William can count to twenty.
examples.fa: ویلیام می‌تواند تا بیست بشمارد.

examples.en: Ryan can't drive yet. He's only fifteen.
examples.fa: رایان هنوز نمی‌تواند رانندگی کند. فقط پانزده سالش است.

examples.en: Can I sit here, please?
examples.fa: می‌توانم اینجا بنشینم، لطفاً؟

practice.prompt: Nicola ___ ride a bike now.
Sorry, I ___ come tonight.
Which sentence is correct?
Which question is correct?
Can I have a glass of water?
answers: Can I have a glass of water?

practice.prompt: Make it negative: "Leslie can swim."

test.prompt: ___ I open the window?
My grandad ___ use a smartphone.
Which sentence is correct?
We can't find the remote.
Make it a question: "You can play the piano."

topics.title: Past simple: regular verbs (-ed)
topics.titleFa: گذشتهٔ ساده: فعل‌های باقاعده (-ed)

teach.en: We use the past simple for finished actions at a finished time: yesterday, last week, in 2019.
teach.fa: گذشتهٔ ساده برای کارهای تمام‌شده در زمانی تمام‌شده است: yesterday، last week، in 2019.

teach.en: Regular verbs add -ed: walk, walked; play, played. If the verb ends in -e, just add -d: live, lived.
teach.fa: فعل‌های باقاعده -ed می‌گیرند: walked، played. اگر فعل به -e ختم شود فقط -d: lived.

teach.en: Watch the spelling: stop, stopped; study, studied. And the past simple is the same for everyone: I walked, she walked.
teach.fa: به املا دقت کنید: stopped، studied. گذشتهٔ ساده برای همه یکی است: I walked، she walked.

examples.en: Nicola jumped in every puddle.
examples.fa: نیکولا توی هر چاله پرید.

examples.en: Tom cooked the turkey on Christmas Day.
examples.fa: تام روز کریسمس بوقلمون را پخت.

examples.en: We stayed in Brighton last summer.
examples.fa: تابستان گذشته در برایتون ماندیم.

practice.prompt: Yesterday Leslie ___ to the shops.
William ___ his toy bus under the bed.
study → ?
Last night we ___ a film on TV.
Ryan finished his homework at nine.
answers: Ryan finished his homework at nine.

practice.prompt: Put it in the past: "I live in Leeds."

test.prompt: Mrs Patel ___ on our door this morning.
stop → ?
They ___ in London for ten years.
Nicola smiled at the baker.
Put it in the past: "She plays the guitar."

topics.title: Past simple: irregular verbs, didn't and Did…?
topics.titleFa: گذشتهٔ ساده: بی‌قاعده، didn't و Did…?

teach.en: Many common verbs are irregular: go, went; have, had; see, saw; buy, bought; eat, ate; take, took.
teach.fa: خیلی از فعل‌های رایج بی‌قاعده‌اند: went، had، saw، bought، ate، took.

teach.en: For the negative, use "didn't" + the basic verb: I didn't go. Not "I didn't went".
teach.fa: برای منفی didn't + شکل سادهٔ فعل: I didn't go (نه I didn't went).

teach.en: For questions, use "Did" + the basic verb: Did you see it? What did you buy?
teach.fa: برای سؤال Did + شکل سادهٔ فعل: Did you see it? What did you buy?

examples.en: Tom left his wallet on the train.
examples.fa: تام کیف پولش را در قطار جا گذاشت.

examples.en: Biscuit ate a little bit of the cake.
examples.fa: بیسکویت یک ذره از کیک را خورد.

examples.en: Did you have a nice weekend?
examples.fa: آخر هفتهٔ خوبی داشتی؟

practice.prompt: We ___ to Brighton on the train.
Ryan ___ a new pair of trainers.
I didn't ___ the news.
Which question is correct?
What did Nicola get for Christmas?
answers: What did Nicola get for Christmas?

practice.prompt: Make it negative: "Tom took the bus."
answers: Tom did not take the bus.

test.prompt: Leslie ___ a cup of tea and sat down.
___ you sleep well?
Which sentence is correct?
answers: She didn't come to the party.
She didn't came to the party.
She not came to the party.

test.prompt: We had fish and chips on the pier.
answers: We had fish and chips on the pier.

test.prompt: Make it a question: "He found his keys."

topics.title: Present continuous: I'm doing it now
topics.titleFa: حال استمراری: الان دارم انجامش می‌دهم

teach.en: Use the present continuous for things happening now, or around now: Look! It's raining.
teach.fa: حال استمراری برای کاری است که الان یا این روزها در جریان است: Look! It's raining.

teach.en: Make it with am, is or are + the -ing form: I'm reading, she's cooking, they're playing.
teach.fa: با am/is/are + فعل ing‌دار ساخته می‌شود: I'm reading، she's cooking، they're playing.

teach.en: Watch the spelling: make, making; run, running; sit, sitting.
teach.fa: به املا دقت کنید: making، running، sitting.

examples.en: Shh! William is sleeping.
examples.fa: هیس! ویلیام خوابیده است.

examples.en: Tom's cooking dinner tonight.
examples.fa: امشب تام شام را درست می‌کند.

examples.en: What are you doing? I'm looking for my keys.
examples.fa: داری چی کار می‌کنی؟ دنبال کلیدهایم می‌گردم.

practice.prompt: Look! Nicola ___ in the puddles.
I ___ my homework at the moment.
run → ?
Where ___ you going?
The children are playing in the garden.
answers: The children are playing in the garden.

practice.prompt: Make it negative: "Ryan is listening."

test.prompt: Mum ___ on the phone right now.
sit → ?
___ it raining in Hackney?
We're having pasta tonight.
Make it a question: "They are waiting for the bus."
answers: Are they waiting for the bus?

topics.title: Present simple or continuous?
topics.titleFa: حال ساده یا استمراری؟

teach.en: Present simple for habits and facts: Tom drives a bus every day.
teach.fa: حال ساده برای عادت‌ها و واقعیت‌ها: Tom drives a bus every day.

teach.en: Present continuous for now: Today he isn't driving. He's watching football.
teach.fa: حال استمراری برای همین الان: Today he isn't driving. He's watching football.

teach.en: Look for clues: every day, usually, never go with the simple; now, at the moment, today, look! go with the continuous.
teach.fa: به نشانه‌ها نگاه کنید: every day، usually، never با حال ساده؛ now، at the moment، today، look! با استمراری.

examples.en: Leslie usually walks to school, but today she's taking the bus.
examples.fa: لزلی معمولاً پیاده به مدرسه می‌رود، اما امروز با اتوبوس می‌رود.

examples.en: Ryan plays football on Saturdays.
examples.fa: رایان شنبه‌ها فوتبال بازی می‌کند.

examples.en: Be quiet! I'm talking to Grandad.
examples.fa: ساکت! دارم با پدربزرگ حرف می‌زنم.

practice.prompt: Nicola ___ milk every morning.
Look! Biscuit ___ on the roof.
We usually ___ dinner at six.
"Where's Tom?" "He ___ a shower."
Ryan never gets up early.
Change "every day" to "now": "I read the news every day." → "I … the news now."
answers: I am reading the news now.

test.prompt: It ___ a lot in London.
Shh! The baby ___.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: Tom is working on Mondays usually.

test.prompt: What are you watching?
Change "now" to "every Sunday": "She is visiting her nan now." → "She … her nan every Sunday."
answers: She visits her nan every Sunday.

topics.title: Comparatives and superlatives
topics.titleFa: صفت تفضیلی و عالی

teach.en: To compare two things, short adjectives add -er + than: Ryan is taller than Nicola.
teach.fa: برای مقایسهٔ دو چیز، صفت‌های کوتاه -er + than می‌گیرند: Ryan is taller than Nicola.

teach.en: Long adjectives use "more": Brighton is more crowded than our street. For the top of a group, use the -est or the most: the tallest, the most beautiful.
teach.fa: صفت‌های بلند با more می‌آیند: more crowded. برای بالاترین در یک گروه: the tallest، the most beautiful.

teach.en: Watch the spelling and the irregulars: big, bigger; happy, happier; good, better, the best; bad, worse, the worst.
teach.fa: به املا و بی‌قاعده‌ها دقت کنید: bigger، happier، good/better/the best، bad/worse/the worst.

examples.en: London is bigger than Brighton.
examples.fa: لندن از برایتون بزرگ‌تر است.

examples.en: These are the best chips in England!
examples.fa: این‌ها بهترین چیپس انگلستان است!

examples.en: Today is colder than yesterday.
examples.fa: امروز از دیروز سردتر است.

practice.prompt: William is ___ than Nicola.
Your cake is ___ than mine!
big → ?
It's the ___ day of the year.
Ryan is taller than his mum now.
answers: Ryan is taller than his mum now.

practice.prompt: Compare them: "The train is fast. The bus is slow." → "The train is … the bus."
answers: The train is faster than the bus.

test.prompt: This is the ___ film I've ever seen!
The park is ___ than the high street.
happy → ?
Nana Maggie is the kindest person I know.
answers: Nana Maggie is the kindest person I know.

test.prompt: Compare them: "Mare Street is busy. Our road is quiet." → "Mare Street is … our road."
answers: Mare Street is busier than our road.

topics.title: Present perfect: ever, never, just, already, yet
topics.titleFa: حال کامل: ever، never، just، already، yet

teach.en: Use the present perfect for life experience and for past actions that matter now: I've been to Scotland. I've lost my keys!
teach.fa: حال کامل برای تجربه‌های زندگی و کارهای گذشته‌ای است که الان مهم‌اند: I've been to Scotland. I've lost my keys!

teach.en: Make it with have or has + the past participle: I've seen, she's finished, they haven't eaten.
teach.fa: با have/has + اسم مفعول ساخته می‌شود: I've seen، she's finished، they haven't eaten.

teach.en: "Just" means a moment ago, "already" means sooner than expected, and "yet" goes at the end of questions and negatives: Have you finished yet?
teach.fa: just یعنی همین الان، already یعنی زودتر از انتظار، و yet در آخر سؤال و منفی می‌آید: Have you finished yet?

examples.en: Have you ever been to Edinburgh?
examples.fa: تا حالا ادینبرو رفته‌ای؟

examples.en: William has just broken a mug.
examples.fa: ویلیام همین الان یک لیوان را شکست.

examples.en: I haven't done the washing-up yet.
examples.fa: هنوز ظرف‌ها را نشسته‌ام.

practice.prompt: Leslie has ___ made a cake. It's on the table!
Have you ___ eaten haggis?
Ryan ___ finished his homework.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: I've never seen the sea in winter.
I've seen never the sea in winter.
I never have seen the sea in winter.

practice.prompt: Tom has lost his bus pass again.
answers: Tom has lost his bus pass again.

practice.prompt: Make it a question with "yet": "You've packed your bag."
answers: Have you packed your bag yet?

test.prompt: Nicola has ___ been on a plane.
We haven't booked the holiday ___.
go → I have ___
Have you ever met Mrs Patel?
answers: Have you ever met Mrs Patel?

test.prompt: Make it negative: "She has finished her tea."
answers: She has not finished her tea.

topics.title: Present perfect or past simple?
topics.titleFa: حال کامل یا گذشتهٔ ساده؟

teach.en: Past simple for a finished time we name: yesterday, last year, in 2015, when I was a child.
teach.fa: گذشتهٔ ساده برای زمانی تمام‌شده که اسمش را می‌آوریم: yesterday، last year، in 2015.

teach.en: Present perfect when the time isn't finished or isn't said: today, this week, ever, recently.
teach.fa: حال کامل وقتی زمان تمام نشده یا گفته نمی‌شود: today، this week، ever، recently.

teach.en: So we say "I've been to Wales" but "I went to Wales last summer". Never "I've been there last summer".
teach.fa: پس می‌گوییم I've been to Wales ولی I went to Wales last summer.

examples.en: I've worked here for six years.
examples.fa: شش سال است که اینجا کار می‌کنم.

examples.en: Tom started driving buses in 2012.
examples.fa: تام از سال ۲۰۱۲ رانندگی اتوبوس را شروع کرد.

examples.en: Have you seen Biscuit this morning?
examples.fa: امروز صبح بیسکویت را دیده‌ای؟

practice.prompt: We ___ to Cornwall last August.
I ___ three cups of tea today.
When ___ you move to Hackney?
Which sentence is correct?
answers: She lived in Leeds when she was a child.
She has lived in Leeds when she was a child.
She has live in Leeds when she was a child.

practice.prompt: Ryan has known Sam since primary school.
answers: Ryan has known Sam since primary school.

practice.prompt: Change "this week" to "last week": "I've seen Gran this week."

test.prompt: Leslie ___ her phone yesterday.
Have you ___ the new café on the high street?
Which sentence is correct?
answers: We lived here since 2018 until now.

test.prompt: Nicola lost a tooth on Monday.
answers: Nicola lost a tooth on Monday.

test.prompt: Put it in the past simple with "yesterday": "He has fixed the boiler."

topics.title: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous
topics.titleFa: زمان آینده: will، going to و حال استمراری

teach.en: "Going to" is for plans you've already made: I'm going to paint the kitchen.
teach.fa: going to برای برنامه‌هایی است که از قبل گرفته‌اید: I'm going to paint the kitchen.

teach.en: "Will" is for quick decisions, offers and predictions: It's cold. I'll make some tea. I think it'll rain.
teach.fa: will برای تصمیم لحظه‌ای، پیشنهاد کمک و پیش‌بینی: I'll make some tea. I think it'll rain.

teach.en: The present continuous is for fixed arrangements with a time: We're seeing the dentist on Friday.
teach.fa: حال استمراری برای قرارهای قطعی با زمان مشخص: We're seeing the dentist on Friday.

examples.en: Don't worry, I'll pick you up from the station.
examples.fa: نگران نباش، از ایستگاه دنبالت می‌آیم.

examples.en: Ryan's going to learn to drive next year.
examples.fa: رایان سال بعد قرار است رانندگی یاد بگیرد.

examples.en: We're having a barbecue on Saturday.
examples.fa: شنبه کباب‌پزی داریم.

practice.prompt: The phone's ringing. I ___ get it!
Look at those clouds. It's ___ rain.

practice.prompt: Make it a plan with "going to": "I will paint the fence."
answers: I'm going to paint the fence.
I am going to paint the fence.

answers: Oh, it's raining. I'll take an umbrella.

test.prompt: Tom is working late on Thursday.
answers: Tom is working late on Thursday.

test.prompt: Make it negative: "She's going to come."
answers: She is not going to come.

topics.title: First conditional: If it rains, we'll…
topics.titleFa: شرطی نوع اول: If it rains, we'll…

teach.en: Use the first conditional for real possibilities in the future: If it rains, we'll stay in.
teach.fa: شرطی نوع اول برای احتمال واقعی در آینده: If it rains, we'll stay in.

teach.en: The pattern is If + present simple, then will + verb. Don't put "will" after "if": If you hurry, not If you will hurry.
teach.fa: الگو: If + حال ساده، سپس will + فعل. بعد از if از will استفاده نکنید.

teach.en: "Unless" means "if not": We'll be late unless we leave now.
teach.fa: unless یعنی «اگر نه»: We'll be late unless we leave now.

examples.en: If you finish your tea, you can have pudding.
examples.fa: اگر شامت را تمام کنی، می‌توانی دسر بخوری.

examples.en: If Biscuit sees a bird, she'll sit at the window all day.
examples.fa: اگر بیسکویت یک پرنده ببیند، تمام روز پشت پنجره می‌نشیند.

examples.en: I won't go unless you come with me.
examples.fa: نمی‌روم مگر اینکه تو هم با من بیایی.

practice.prompt: If you ___ the 38 bus, you'll get there faster.
If it's sunny tomorrow, we ___ to the park.
You'll miss the train ___ you hurry up.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: If I see Ryan, I'll tell him.
If I will see Ryan, I'll tell him.
If I see Ryan, I tell him tomorrow.

practice.prompt: If you're cold, I'll put the heating on.
answers: If you're cold, I'll put the heating on.

practice.prompt: Join with "if": "You touch the oven. You'll burn your hand."
answers: If you touch the oven, you'll burn your hand.
If you touch the oven, you will burn your hand.

test.prompt: If Nicola ___ tired, she'll go to bed early.
We'll have a picnic unless it ___.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: If you ask him, he'll help.
If you'll ask him, he helps.
If you asked him, he'll help.

test.prompt: If we leave now, we'll catch the bus.
answers: If we leave now, we'll catch the bus.

test.prompt: Use "unless": "If you don't eat, you'll be hungry."
answers: Unless you eat, you'll be hungry.
Unless you eat, you will be hungry.
You'll be hungry unless you eat.

topics.title: Modals: have to, must, should, might
topics.titleFa: فعل‌های وجهی: have to، must، should، might

teach.en: "Have to" and "must" mean it's necessary: I have to work on Saturday. You must wear a seat belt.
teach.fa: have to و must یعنی لازم است: I have to work on Saturday.

teach.en: "Don't have to" means it isn't necessary, but "mustn't" means don't do it: You don't have to come. You mustn't smoke here.
teach.fa: don't have to یعنی لازم نیست، ولی mustn't یعنی ممنوع است.

teach.en: "Should" gives advice, and "might" or "could" means maybe: You should see a GP. It might snow tonight.
teach.fa: should برای توصیه، might و could یعنی شاید: You should see a GP. It might snow tonight.

examples.en: You don't have to wear school uniform on Friday.
examples.fa: جمعه لازم نیست لباس مدرسه بپوشی.

examples.en: You mustn't feed Biscuit chocolate.
examples.fa: نباید به بیسکویت شکلات بدهی.

examples.en: Take a coat. It might get chilly later.
examples.fa: کت بردار. شاید بعداً سرد شود.

practice.prompt: It's Sunday, so Tom ___ get up early.
You look tired. You ___ go to bed.
Take an umbrella. It ___ rain later.
Which means "it's not allowed"?
answers: You don't have to park here.

practice.prompt: Ryan has to revise for his exams.
answers: Ryan has to revise for his exams.

practice.prompt: Make it advice with "should": "Drink more water."

test.prompt: Children ___ cross the road without an adult.
Leslie ___ work late tonight because of a meeting.
Which is advice?
We might go to the seaside tomorrow.
answers: We might go to the seaside tomorrow.

test.prompt: Make it negative with "don't have to": "You have to pay."
answers: You do not have to pay.

topics.title: Second conditional: If I won, I would…
topics.titleFa: شرطی نوع دوم: If I won, I would…

teach.en: Use the second conditional for imaginary or unlikely situations now or in the future: If I won the lottery, I'd buy a cottage.
teach.fa: شرطی نوع دوم برای موقعیت‌های خیالی یا بعید در حال یا آینده: If I won the lottery, I'd buy a cottage.

teach.en: The pattern is If + past simple, then would + verb. It's about now, even though it uses a past form.
teach.fa: الگو: If + گذشتهٔ ساده، سپس would + فعل. با اینکه شکل گذشته دارد، دربارهٔ حال است.

teach.en: For advice, British people often say "If I were you…": If I were you, I'd ring them.
teach.fa: برای توصیه زیاد می‌گویند If I were you: If I were you, I'd ring them.

examples.en: If I didn't have work, I'd stay in bed all day.
examples.fa: اگر کار نداشتم، تمام روز در رختخواب می‌ماندم.

examples.en: If we had a garden, we'd get a trampoline.
examples.fa: اگر حیاط داشتیم، ترامپولین می‌خریدیم.

examples.en: If I were you, I'd take the train.
examples.fa: من جای تو بودم، با قطار می‌رفتم.

practice.prompt: If I ___ more time, I'd learn the piano.
If Tom won the lottery, he ___ stop working.
If I ___ you, I'd say sorry.
Which is about an imaginary situation?
answers: If I lived by the sea, I'd swim every day.
If I live by the sea, I'll swim every day.
If I lived by the sea, I swim every day.

practice.prompt: If Nicola could fly, she would visit the moon.
answers: If Nicola could fly, she would visit the moon.

practice.prompt: Make it imaginary: "If it rains, we'll stay in."
answers: If it rained, we'd stay in.
If it rained, we would stay in.

test.prompt: What would you do if you ___ a ghost?
If we had a car, we ___ drive to Wales.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: If I were rich, I'd travel the world.
If I would be rich, I'd travel the world.
If I am rich, I'd travel the world.

test.prompt: I'd help you if I knew the answer.
answers: I'd help you if I knew the answer.

test.prompt: Give advice with "If I were you": "Ring the bank."
answers: If I were you, I'd ring the bank.
If I were you, I would ring the bank.

topics.title: Third conditional and regrets
topics.titleFa: شرطی نوع سوم و حسرت

teach.en: Use the third conditional to imagine a different past: If I'd left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the train.
teach.fa: شرطی نوع سوم برای تصور گذشته‌ای متفاوت: If I'd left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the train.

teach.en: The pattern is If + had + past participle, then would have + past participle.
teach.fa: الگو: If + had + اسم مفعول، سپس would have + اسم مفعول.

teach.en: For regrets and criticism, use should have or shouldn't have: I should have listened. You shouldn't have shouted.
teach.fa: برای حسرت و انتقاد should have / shouldn't have: I should have listened.

examples.en: If Ryan had revised, he would have passed.
examples.fa: اگر رایان درس خوانده بود، قبول می‌شد.

examples.en: If we hadn't stopped for chips, we'd have been on time.
examples.fa: اگر برای چیپس نایستاده بودیم، سر وقت رسیده بودیم.

examples.en: I should have brought a coat. It's freezing!
examples.fa: باید کت آورده بودم. خیلی سرد است!

practice.prompt: If I had known, I ___ have told you.
If Leslie ___ the alarm, she wouldn't have overslept.

answers: If it hadn't rained, we would have gone out.
If it didn't rain, we would have gone out.
If it hadn't rained, we would went out.

practice.prompt: I should have checked the bus times.
answers: I should have checked the bus times.

practice.prompt: Make a regret with "should have": "I didn't book a table."
answers: I should have booked a table.

test.prompt: If Tom had seen the sign, he ___ have stopped.
If they ___ the map, they wouldn't have got lost.
Which is criticism of a past action?
answers: You shouldn't have left the door open.
You don't have to leave the door open.
You won't leave the door open.

test.prompt: If we had left earlier, we would have caught it.
answers: If we had left earlier, we would have caught it.

test.prompt: Use the third conditional: "I didn't know. I didn't come."
answers: If I had known, I would have come.
If I'd known, I would have come.
If I'd known, I'd have come.

topics.title: The passive: It was built in 1890
topics.titleFa: مجهول: It was built in 1890

teach.en: Use the passive when the action matters more than who does it, or when we don't know who: The bins are collected on Tuesdays.
teach.fa: مجهول وقتی کار مهم‌تر از کننده است یا کننده را نمی‌دانیم: The bins are collected on Tuesdays.

teach.en: Make it with be + past participle: it is made, it was taken, it has been sold, it will be delivered.
teach.fa: با be + اسم مفعول: it is made، it was taken، it has been sold، it will be delivered.

teach.en: Add "by" only if the person is important: The bridge was designed by a famous engineer.
teach.fa: فقط اگر کننده مهم است by بیاورید: designed by a famous engineer.

examples.en: Our street was built in the 1890s.
examples.fa: خیابان ما در دههٔ ۱۸۹۰ ساخته شد.

examples.en: Tom's bike has been stolen!
examples.fa: دوچرخهٔ تام دزدیده شده!

examples.en: Your parcel will be delivered tomorrow.
examples.fa: بستهٔ شما فردا تحویل داده می‌شود.

practice.prompt: The bins ___ collected every Tuesday.
This photo ___ taken in Brighton in 2019.
The boiler has ___ fixed at last.
Which sentence is passive?
answers: The cake was eaten by Biscuit.

practice.prompt: The windows are cleaned once a month.
answers: The windows are cleaned once a month.

practice.prompt: Make it passive: "Someone stole my phone."

test.prompt: English ___ spoken all over the world.
The new library will ___ opened next week.

answers: Ryan was given a prize at school.

test.prompt: Make it passive: "They make these biscuits in Scotland."
answers: These biscuits are made in Scotland.

topics.title: Reported speech: She said she was…
topics.titleFa: نقل قول غیرمستقیم: She said she was…

teach.en: When we report what someone said, we usually move the tense back: "I'm tired" becomes She said she was tired.
teach.fa: در نقل قول غیرمستقیم معمولاً زمان یک قدم به گذشته می‌رود: She said she was tired.

teach.en: "Say" doesn't need a person, but "tell" does: He said that… / He told me that…
teach.fa: say به مفعول نیاز ندارد ولی tell دارد: He said that… / He told me that…

teach.en: For questions, use asked if or asked + question word, in normal word order: She asked where I lived.
teach.fa: برای سؤال asked if یا asked + کلمهٔ پرسشی با ترتیب جملهٔ خبری: She asked where I lived.

examples.en: Leslie said she'd be home by six.
examples.fa: لزلی گفت تا ساعت شش خانه است.

examples.en: Nicola told me she had a wobbly tooth.
examples.fa: نیکولا به من گفت دندانش لق است.

examples.en: The doctor asked if I was sleeping well.
examples.fa: دکتر پرسید آیا خوب می‌خوابم.

practice.prompt: Tom said he ___ hungry.
Ryan ___ me he had a new phone.
She asked me where I ___.
"I will help you." → He said he ___ help me.
Gran asked if we were coming for lunch.
answers: Gran asked if we were coming for lunch.

practice.prompt: Report it: Leslie: "I'm making a cake."
answers: Leslie said she was making a cake.
Leslie said that she was making a cake.

test.prompt: Mrs Patel ___ that the shop was closed.
He asked ___ I liked football.
"Where do you live?" → She asked me ___
Nicola said she was going to be a vet.
answers: Nicola said she was going to be a vet.

test.prompt: Report it: Ryan: "I can't find my keys."
answers: Ryan said he couldn't find his keys.
Ryan said that he couldn't find his keys.

topics.title: used to, would and be used to
topics.titleFa: used to، would و be used to

teach.en: "Used to" is for past habits and states that aren't true now: I used to live in Leeds.
teach.fa: used to برای عادت‌ها و حالت‌های گذشته که دیگر درست نیستند: I used to live in Leeds.

teach.en: "Would" can also describe past habits, but not states: Every summer we'd go to Skegness.
teach.fa: would هم برای عادت گذشته است، ولی نه حالت: Every summer we'd go to Skegness.

teach.en: "Be used to" or "get used to" + -ing means something is normal for you now: I'm used to driving on the left.
teach.fa: be/get used to + ing یعنی چیزی برایتان عادی شده: I'm used to driving on the left.

examples.en: Tom used to have long hair.
examples.fa: تام قبلاً موی بلند داشت.

examples.en: On Sundays, Gran would make a huge roast.
examples.fa: یکشنبه‌ها مادربزرگ یک کباب بزرگ درست می‌کرد.

examples.en: I'm still getting used to the British weather.
examples.fa: هنوز دارم به هوای بریتانیا عادت می‌کنم.

practice.prompt: When I was little, I ___ to hate broccoli.
Did you ___ to walk to school?
Leslie is used to ___ up early.
Which one can't use "would"?
answers: I used to have a dog.
I used to play outside every day.
I used to visit Gran on Sundays.

practice.prompt: We used to live above a shop.
answers: We used to live above a shop.

practice.prompt: Make it negative: "I used to like tea."
answers: I didn't use to like tea.

It took Ryan a month to get used to ___ his new school.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: She didn't use to drink coffee.
She didn't used to drinking coffee.
She use to not drink coffee.

test.prompt: There used to be a cinema here.
answers: There used to be a cinema here.

test.prompt: Rewrite with "used to": "I played football when I was younger, but I don't now."
answers: I used to play football when I was younger.

topics.title: Inversion: Never have I… / Not only…
topics.titleFa: وارونگی: Never have I… / Not only…

teach.en: After a negative or limiting word at the start, we swap the subject and auxiliary, like a question: Never have I seen such rain.
teach.fa: بعد از یک کلمهٔ منفی یا محدودکننده در ابتدای جمله، فاعل و فعل کمکی جابه‌جا می‌شوند، مثل سؤال: Never have I seen such rain.

teach.en: Common openers: Never, Rarely, Seldom, Not only… but also, Hardly… when, No sooner… than, Under no circumstances, Only then.
teach.fa: شروع‌کننده‌های رایج: Never، Rarely، Seldom، Not only… but also، Hardly… when، No sooner… than، Under no circumstances، Only then.

teach.en: If there's no auxiliary, add do, does or did: Rarely does Tom complain. It sounds formal or dramatic, so save it for speeches, writing and storytelling.
teach.fa: اگر فعل کمکی نیست do/does/did اضافه کنید: Rarely does Tom complain. لحنش رسمی یا نمایشی است؛ برای سخنرانی، نوشتن و قصه‌گویی.

examples.en: Never have I been so proud of this family.
examples.fa: هیچ‌وقت این‌قدر به این خانواده افتخار نکرده بودم.

examples.en: Not only did Ryan pass, but he also got the top mark.
examples.fa: رایان نه‌تنها قبول شد، بلکه بالاترین نمره را هم گرفت.

examples.en: No sooner had we sat down than the fire alarm went off.
examples.fa: تازه نشسته بودیم که آژیر آتش به صدا درآمد.

practice.prompt: Never ___ I tasted such a good scone.
Rarely ___ Leslie leave work before six.
Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the tickets.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: Under no circumstances should you open this door.
Under no circumstances you should open this door.
Under no circumstances should open you this door.

practice.prompt: Hardly had the match started when it began to pour.
answers: Hardly had the match started when it began to pour.

practice.prompt: Start with "Never": "I have never felt so tired."
answers: Never have I felt so tired.

test.prompt: No sooner ___ we arrived than the rain stopped.
Seldom ___ you see a fox in the daytime.
Which is the formal, inverted version?
answers: Only then did I realise my mistake.
Only then I realised my mistake.
Only then I did realise my mistake.

test.prompt: Not only is she clever, but she is also kind.
answers: Not only is she clever, but she is also kind.

test.prompt: Start with "Rarely": "We rarely eat out on a weekday."
answers: Rarely do we eat out on a weekday.

topics.title: Mixed conditionals
topics.titleFa: شرطی‌های ترکیبی

teach.en: Mixed conditionals join two times. A past condition with a present result: If I'd taken that job, I'd be living in Manchester now.
teach.fa: شرطی ترکیبی دو زمان را به هم وصل می‌کند. شرط گذشته با نتیجهٔ حال: If I'd taken that job, I'd be living in Manchester now.

teach.en: Or a present state with a past result: If I weren't so shy, I would have spoken to her.
teach.fa: یا حالت حال با نتیجهٔ گذشته: If I weren't so shy, I would have spoken to her.

teach.en: Check the time of each half: "had + past participle" looks back, "would + verb" is about now, "would have + past participle" is about the past.
teach.fa: زمان هر نیمه را بسنجید: had + اسم مفعول به گذشته نگاه می‌کند، would + فعل دربارهٔ حال است، would have + اسم مفعول دربارهٔ گذشته.

examples.en: If Tom hadn't missed that bus, he wouldn't have met Leslie, and Nicola wouldn't be here!
examples.fa: اگر تام آن اتوبوس را از دست نداده بود، لزلی را نمی‌دید و حالا نیکولا اینجا نبود!

examples.en: If I were better with money, I wouldn't have bought that sofa.
examples.fa: اگر حساب پول دستم بود، آن کاناپه را نمی‌خریدم.

examples.en: If Ryan had revised, he'd be on holiday now instead of resitting.
examples.fa: اگر رایان درس خوانده بود، حالا به‌جای امتحان مجدد در تعطیلات بود.

practice.prompt: If I had gone to bed earlier, I ___ so tired now.
If she ___ afraid of flying, she would have come to Spain with us.
If we'd bought that house, we ___ next door to Gran now.
Which is a past condition with a present result?
answers: If I'd learnt Welsh as a child, I'd speak it now.
If I learnt Welsh, I'd speak it.
If I learn Welsh, I'll speak it.

practice.prompt: If he had saved more, he would be retired now.
answers: If he had saved more, he would be retired now.

practice.prompt: Make it a mixed conditional: "I didn't eat breakfast, so I'm hungry now."
answers: If I had eaten breakfast, I wouldn't be hungry now.
If I'd eaten breakfast, I wouldn't be hungry now.
If I had eaten breakfast, I would not be hungry now.

test.prompt: If Leslie ___ the train, she'd be home by now.
If I were taller, I ___ joined the basketball team years ago.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: If you hadn't lost the map, we wouldn't be lost now.
If you didn't lose the map, we wouldn't be lost now.
If you hadn't lost the map, we won't be lost now.

test.prompt: If I spoke French, I would have applied.
answers: If I spoke French, I would have applied.

test.prompt: Make it a mixed conditional: "He isn't careful, so he broke the vase."
answers: If he were careful, he wouldn't have broken the vase.
If he was careful, he wouldn't have broken the vase.
If he were more careful, he wouldn't have broken the vase.

topics.title: wish, if only and it's time
topics.titleFa: wish، if only و it's time

teach.en: Wish or if only + past simple for present regrets: I wish I lived nearer the sea. If only it weren't raining.
teach.fa: wish یا if only + گذشتهٔ ساده برای حسرت دربارهٔ حال: I wish I lived nearer the sea.

teach.en: Wish + past perfect for past regrets: I wish I hadn't said that. Wish + would for annoying habits: I wish you'd stop tapping!
teach.fa: wish + ماضی بعید برای حسرت گذشته: I wish I hadn't said that. wish + would برای عادت‌های آزاردهنده: I wish you'd stop tapping!

teach.en: "It's time" or "It's high time" + past simple means it should happen now: It's high time we left.
teach.fa: It's (high) time + گذشتهٔ ساده یعنی وقتش رسیده: It's high time we left.

examples.en: I wish I had more time with the kids.
examples.fa: کاش وقت بیشتری با بچه‌ها داشتم.

examples.en: If only we'd booked a table!
examples.fa: کاش میز رزرو کرده بودیم!

examples.en: I wish Biscuit would stop sleeping on my clean washing.
examples.fa: کاش بیسکویت این‌قدر روی لباس‌های تمیزم نخوابد.

practice.prompt: I wish I ___ drive. The bus takes ages.
If only I ___ that last slice of cake. I feel awful.
It's high time you ___ your room, Ryan.
Which is about an annoying habit?
answers: I wish you would put the lid back on.
I wish you put the lid back on yesterday.
I wish you had put the lid back on.

practice.prompt: I wish we had gone to the beach.
answers: I wish we had gone to the beach.

practice.prompt: Make a wish about now: "I don't have a garden."
answers: I wish I had a garden.
If only I had a garden.

test.prompt: I wish it ___ so cold today.
She wishes she ___ the job. She regrets it now.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: It's time we will go home.

test.prompt: If only I knew the answer.
answers: If only I knew the answer.

test.prompt: Make a past regret with "wish": "I didn't bring an umbrella."
answers: I wish I had brought an umbrella.
I wish I'd brought an umbrella.

topics.title: Cleft sentences: What I need is… / It was… who…
topics.titleFa: جملات شکافته: What I need is… / It was… who…

teach.en: Cleft sentences split one idea into two parts to point at the important bit: What I need is a cup of tea.
teach.fa: جملهٔ شکافته یک ایده را دو تکه می‌کند تا روی بخش مهم تأکید کند: What I need is a cup of tea.

teach.en: "It is / It was … that / who …" puts the focus at the front: It was Nicola who broke the vase, not William.
teach.fa: It is / It was … that / who … تأکید را جلو می‌آورد: It was Nicola who broke the vase, not William.

teach.en: Other useful patterns: All I want is…, The thing is…, The reason why… is…, What happened was…
teach.fa: الگوهای دیگر: All I want is…، The thing is…، The reason why… is…، What happened was…

examples.en: What I love about Hackney is the markets.
examples.fa: چیزی که در هکنی دوست دارم بازارهایش است.

examples.en: It was Tom who found Biscuit in the end.
examples.fa: آخرش تام بود که بیسکویت را پیدا کرد.

examples.en: All I want for my birthday is a quiet day.
examples.fa: تنها چیزی که برای تولدم می‌خواهم یک روز آرام است.

practice.prompt: What I need right now ___ a long holiday.
It was Leslie ___ remembered Gran's birthday.
___ I don't understand is why he left.
Which sentence puts the focus on "the noise"?
answers: What annoys me is the noise.
The noise annoys me a bit.
It annoys me, the noise is.

practice.prompt: It was in Brighton that they first met.
answers: It was in Brighton that they first met.

practice.prompt: Focus with "What": "I really want a nap."
answers: What I really want is a nap.

test.prompt: All I asked for ___ a bit of help.
It's the weather ___ makes me miss home.
Which is a cleft sentence?
answers: The reason why I'm late is the traffic.
I'm late because of the traffic.
Because of the traffic, I'm late.

test.prompt: What happened was that the car broke down.
answers: What happened was that the car broke down.

test.prompt: Focus on "Ryan" with "It was … who": "Ryan ate the last biscuit."
answers: It was Ryan who ate the last biscuit.
It was Ryan that ate the last biscuit.

topics.title: Causative and advanced passive: have it done, is said to…
topics.titleFa: سببی و مجهول پیشرفته: have it done، is said to…

teach.en: Use have or get + object + past participle when someone else does a job for you: We're having the boiler serviced. I got my hair cut.
teach.fa: have یا get + مفعول + اسم مفعول وقتی کسی کاری را برایتان انجام می‌دهد: We're having the boiler serviced.

teach.en: The same pattern is used for bad things that happen to you: Tom had his bike stolen.
teach.fa: همین الگو برای اتفاق بدی است که برایتان می‌افتد: Tom had his bike stolen.

teach.en: For reports and rumours, use the passive with say, believe or think: It is said that… or He is believed to be… For the past: She is thought to have left.
teach.fa: برای گزارش و شایعه: It is said that… یا He is believed to be… برای گذشته: She is thought to have left.

examples.en: Leslie is getting her eyes tested on Friday.
examples.fa: لزلی جمعه چشم‌هایش را معاینه می‌کند.

examples.en: We had a new kitchen fitted last spring.
examples.fa: بهار گذشته آشپزخانهٔ جدید برایمان نصب کردند.

examples.en: The pub is said to be the oldest in London.
examples.fa: می‌گویند این میخانه قدیمی‌ترین میخانهٔ لندن است.

practice.prompt: I'm going to have my car ___ tomorrow.
Ryan got his phone ___ on the bus.
The castle is believed ___ 900 years old.
Which means someone else did it for you?
We need to get the roof fixed.
answers: We need to get the roof fixed.

practice.prompt: Use "have … done": "A man is painting our house for us."
answers: We are having our house painted.

test.prompt: Where do you get your hair ___?
The thief is thought ___ the country last night.
Which sentence is correct?
answers: It is said that the house is haunted.
It is said the house to be haunted.
It says that the house is haunted by people.

test.prompt: Tom had his wallet stolen in town.
answers: Tom had his wallet stolen in town.

test.prompt: Rewrite with "is said to": "People say that he is very rich."
answers: He is said to be very rich.
